caption: The drawing features a single glass bottle with a bluish-green tint, centrally positioned against a plain, light-colored background. The bottle has a narrow, cylindrical neck and a wider, rounded body that tapers inward toward the base. The surface of the bottle is decorated with prominent swirling and curvilinear patterns in relief, which cover both the upper and lower sections. Shadows and highlights are depicted to show the reflective and translucent qualities of the glass, with shading variably indicating thickness and curvature. There is a small handwritten signature at the lower right of the drawing. No other objects or elements are present in the image.
title: Blue-Green Corset Flask
